title: Manual Resolve Decision
description: The document carried by manual-resolve-accepted/v1 and manual-resolve-rejected/v1 — the counterparty's answer to a manual resolve. ONE document, TWO event types: a transition edge is chosen by event type and may never read a payload field, so the two outcomes cannot share a type. The requester may not answer their own request. An acceptance resolves every exception the request cited and the valuation engine then completes the report; a refusal must say why, as a report rejection must, so the requester can answer it. The event cites the request and its exceptions in its reference list.

reportId.description: The report this answer is about.

status.description: Whether the request was accepted or refused. Carried in the document, as report-status carries its own: the two event types exist so a transition edge can be chosen without reading a payload, and the document still has to say which answer it is for every other reader.

exceptionIds.description: The exceptions the request cited, carried here so a reader need not walk back through the request. Mirrors the event's own reference list.

decidedBy.description: The organization answering. Events carry roles rather than organizations, so the document pins the organization.

reason.description: Required when refusing, so the requester can answer it. Optional on an acceptance.
